import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def power_mod(base, exp):
    result = 1
    for bit in range(30, -1, -1):
        result = (result * result) % MOD
        if (1 << bit) & exp:
            result = (result * base) % MOD
    return result

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])

    seen = [0] * p

    if k == 1:
        print(power_mod(p, p))
        return

    ans = 0
    for i in range(1, p):
        if not seen[i]:
            seen[i] = 1
            ans += 1
            cur = (i * k) % p
            while not seen[cur]:
                seen[cur] = 1
                cur = (cur * k) % p

    print(power_mod(p, ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
